item.title: Rats sightings, 15th August
item.description:
Rats have been seen on a number of occasions along Lennard Road, particularly between numbers 76 and 86, and have also been observed in Morland Road and Tennyson Road. The sightings appear to indicate an increasing rat problem in the immediate area. If this is allowed to continue, there is a risk of the infestation becoming established and spreading further, potentially causing a public health risk, damage to property and harm to the local environment. Please could the Council investigate the source of the problem and take appropriate pest-control and preventative action as soon as possible.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Morland Road, Penge, Greater London

item.title: Rubbish in front of the bin store of the large estate in Lucey Way, in front of the bridge in Lucey Way and at the bins on St James Road. Feces all over Lucey Way, 15th August
item.description:
This whole street is always so dirty: every day someone leaves rubbish in front of the bin store, in front of the railway bridge and around the bins on St James Road. We are talking about piles or rubbish. We have also noticed people simply dumping rubbish from the windows of the large estate in Lucey Way. There are also often feces on the street. This is a Public Health concern. Please fix this permanently, not just by removing the rubbish but by ensuring it doesn't happen again.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Lucey Way, Bermondsey, Greater London
